page.title: Day 7: the emphasis Neave set and the site lost
page.standfirst_html:
The checker reports 83 lost runs on Day 7, plus 5 added and 2 swapped. I checked every one against the source page image, because pdftotext discards emphasis, so the image is the only place these claims can be checked.

If you accept every proposal, Day 7 goes from 83 lost to 1, 5 added to 0 and 2 swapped to 0. I measured that by re-running the checker on a copy of the day with all the proposals applied. The one run left over is the card marked No defect, which confirms the record and the checker agree.

Most of the page is Restore italics, and every card there starts set to Restore, so you only need to skim it for exceptions. Your judgment is needed in Fix proposed. Four of those cards are Neave's reverse italics: an italic comment with a newspaper or book title set upright inside it. The site got all four wrong. One card is a live bug that prints literal asterisks on the published page.

sections.title: Restore, remove or move — decide one by one
sections.note_html: Where judgment is needed: italics the site put in the wrong place, spans that start or stop in the wrong place, part-word italics, and one live rendering bug. Four of these are Neave's reverse italics — an italic comment with a title set upright inside it — which the site got wrong every time. Nothing here is preset.
